entries.title: Cut off food, cut off life
entries.literal_meaning: Stopping someone’s food and cutting off their head are called the same thing.
entries.explanation: The dictionary places the saying under stopping someone’s food. Its stark comparison gives deprivation the force of a threat to life. Our reading treats that equivalence as rhetorical emphasis on food’s importance, not a clinical equation or an instruction to injure anyone. The line does not identify who withholds food or describe an actual incident.
entries.meaning_odia: ଅଭିଧାନରେ ଧାଡ଼ିଟି ଖାଦ୍ୟ ବନ୍ଦ କରିବା ଅର୍ଥ ତଳେ ଅଛି। ତୀବ୍ର ତୁଳନାଟି ଖାଦ୍ୟରୁ ବଞ୍ଚିତ କରିବାକୁ ଜୀବନ ପ୍ରତି ବିପଦ ପରି ଦେଖାଏ। ଆମ ପାଠ ଏହାକୁ ଖାଦ୍ୟର ଗୁରୁତ୍ୱ ଉପରେ ଜୋର ବୋଲି ବୁଝେ, ଚିକିତ୍ସାଗତ ସମାନତା ବା କାହାକୁ ଆଘାତ ଦେବା ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦେଶ ନୁହେଁ। କିଏ ଖାଦ୍ୟ ବନ୍ଦ କଲା ବା ସତରେ କଣ ଘଟିଲା, କୁହାଯାଇନାହିଁ।
entries.english_summary: Our reading takes the food-deprivation warning seriously without literalizing its violence.
entries.odia_summary: ଆମ ପାଠ ଖାଦ୍ୟରୁ ବଞ୍ଚନାର ଗୁରୁତ୍ୱ ଦେଖେ, ହିଂସାକୁ ଆକ୍ଷରିକ ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦେଶ କରେନାହିଁ।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: ସମୂହ ଭୋଜନର ତାଲିକାରେ କାହାର ନାମ ଛାଡ଼ିଗଲା କି ନାହିଁ ଦଳଟି ପୁଣି ଦେଖିଲା। / Organizers check that nobody has been omitted from a shared meal. This scene is invented.
entries.cultural_context: Sense1 is distinct from eating smaller portions in later senses. No dietary, medical or financial recommendation, verified deprivation event or traditional charity rule is supplied.

entries.title: A hundred utterances, one writing
entries.literal_meaning: Provisional reading: a hundred utterances, one written record.
entries.explanation: The source places this compact fragment under matter committed to writing. Our reading understands the contrasting term as spoken utterances, but the head does not separately gloss it. The numbers set many beside one; no verb supplies a precise equation or legal rule. We read an invitation to consider what writing preserves, not proof that every written statement is true.
entries.meaning_odia: ଲିଖିତ ବିଷୟ ଅର୍ଥ ତଳେ ଉତ୍ସ ଏହି ଛୋଟ ଖଣ୍ଡଟି ରଖେ। ଭାକାକୁ ମୁହଁର କଥା ଭାବେ ନେଇ ଆମେ ସମ୍ଭାବ୍ୟ ପାଠ ଦେଉଛୁ; ଏହି ଶବ୍ଦର ଅଲଗା ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟା ଏଠି ନାହିଁ। ସଂଖ୍ୟା ଅନେକ ପାଖରେ ଗୋଟିଏକୁ ରଖେ, କିନ୍ତୁ କ୍ରିୟା ନଥିବାରୁ ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦିଷ୍ଟ ସମୀକରଣ ବା ଆଇନର ନିୟମ ମିଳେନାହିଁ। ଆମ ପାଠ ଲେଖା କଣ ରଖିପାରେ ଭାବେ, ସବୁ ଲେଖା ସତ ବୋଲି ମାନେନାହିଁ।
entries.english_summary: Our provisional reading compares speech and writing without inventing a full rule.
entries.odia_summary: ଆମ ସମ୍ଭାବ୍ୟ ପାଠ କଥା ଓ ଲେଖାକୁ ତୁଳନା କରେ, ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ନିୟମ ଗଢ଼େନାହିଁ।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: ଆଲୋଚନା ପରେ ଦଳଟି ଠିକ୍ ହୋଇଥିବା କାମଗୁଡ଼ିକ ଲେଖିଲା ଓ ସମସ୍ତଙ୍କୁ ପୁଣି ପଢ଼ି ଶୁଣାଇଲା। / A group writes and checks its agreed tasks together. This application is invented.
entries.cultural_context: Exact ଭାକା and fused ଏକଲେଖା remain unchanged. Other sayings and Krishna Singh literary examples in this long head are separate witnesses, not this fragment’s authorship.

entries.title: Coming and going alone
entries.literal_meaning: You came alone and will go alone; the family will not go with you.
entries.explanation: The repeated solitude stands against the family named in the final phrase. The dictionary gives family members, including children, as the relevant sense. Our reading hears a reflection on mortality and the limits of accompaniment. That interpretation does not make family affection worthless, require withdrawal from loved ones, or prove a doctrine about what follows death.
entries.meaning_odia: ପୁଣିପୁଣି ଆସୁଥିବା ଏକାପଣ ପାଖରେ ଶେଷ ଖଣ୍ଡ ପରିବାରକୁ ରଖେ। ଅଭିଧାନରେ ପିଲାମାନଙ୍କ ସହ ପରିବାରସ୍ଥ ବ୍ୟକ୍ତି ଅର୍ଥ ଅଛି। ଆମ ପାଠ ଏଠି ମୃତ୍ୟୁ ଓ ସାଙ୍ଗରେ ରହିପାରିବାର ସୀମା ନେଇ ଭାବନା ଶୁଣେ। ଏହା ଆମ ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟା; ପରିବାରର ସ୍ନେହ ମୂଲ୍ୟହୀନ ବୋଲି ନୁହେଁ। ପ୍ରିୟଜନଙ୍କୁ ଛାଡ଼ି ରହିବା ବା ମୃତ୍ୟୁ ପରେ କଣ ହୁଏ ସେବିଷୟରେ ନିଶ୍ଚିତ ମତ ମଧ୍ୟ ନୁହେଁ।
entries.english_summary: Our reading holds life’s limits beside the value of present companionship.
entries.odia_summary: ଆମ ପାଠ ଜୀବନର ସୀମା ସହ ବର୍ତ୍ତମାନର ସାଙ୍ଗତ୍ୟର ମୂଲ୍ୟ ରଖେ।
